text:
This is our second visit to this clinic, and we're still very impressed. The doctor is incredibly kind, assessing our facial features beforehand to determine which areas need improvement to best meet our needs. She explains everything clearly, including the order of procedures. Importantly, you can scan a QR code to verify the products. They open the bottles and draw the medication in front of you for every case – no need to worry about counterfeits! You can rest assured it's 100% safe. The doctor even showed us how to check the medication at a basic level. I highly recommend this clinic for anyone considering facial treatments. You can try a free consultation first; the sales staff won't push any courses, making the experience comfortable. It's located on the 4th floor of CentralFestival, opposite Chester's Grill, making it convenient and parking easy!

P.S. The last picture was taken immediately after one side of my face was treated with HIFU. My face is already lifted! I'll wait to see the full results in two weeks. Stay tuned! 😌
